summary: Layer 1B expands the node from obvious AI infrastructure platforms into smaller electrical, cooling, and rack-level component suppliers. Reference lane confirms that AI density is pushing demand toward integrated power and liquid-cooling infrastructure. Underfollowed lane highlights Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and packaged electrical systems, Modine for data-center cooling via Airedale, and Bel Fuse for power, connectivity, and magnetics components used in AI/cloud data-center architectures.
